goal: Accessibility and text audit, touching only what a mouse-and-keyboard player would: every screen and panel; cut-off, overlapping, unclear or misspelled text; contrast; anything only explained on hover.

findings.title: Inventory Info panel jumps to mid-screen after founding a nation and is then covered by the tip panel
findings.detail: Before a nation the Inventory Info panel sits bottom-left. After N (create nation) the left column grows (Era detail + green 'Sheltered until the Town era...' paragraph) and Inventory Info relocates to about (220,320), in the play view. Tip 3 'Gather stone' then draws over it, hiding 'Inventory Info (I)' and cutting 'Coins: 38...'. Expected HUD panels to keep fixed anchors and never overlap.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 109; space; Start; Begin; click Era box; walkto tree; e e; n; walkto rock; e; pt shot

findings.title: Title, main menu and Config screens: white text on light sky-blue, low contrast
findings.detail: Title prompt, menu buttons and Config labels are white/small on ~#72A5E5 with buttons ~#5C9EEB: roughly 2.5:1, under WCAG AA 4.5:1; button edges almost invisible against the background. In-world dark panels are fine by comparison.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 109; pt shot; space; pt shot

findings.title: Chronicle full-history window is translucent; HUD text behind it overlaps its controls
findings.detail: With Y, the Chronicle window lets the Objective-complete popup, Era panel, Inventory and Season panels show through; 'Close  Y cycles views' collides with 'Objective complete!'. Expected an opaque window or dimmed HUD.
findings.repro: after founding a nation: pt key y

findings.title: Chronicle recent panel truncates every entry with '...'
findings.detail: Each line cuts at ~55 chars ('the nation of Lowerham was born, with Grace Da...'). Who founded what is only readable by opening Y. Expected wrapping or a 2-line entry.
findings.repro: play until other nations are founded (~tick 1700); look at top chronicle panel

findings.title: Disabled action buttons and HUD abbreviations give no reason and have no hover tooltip
findings.detail: Greyed 'Enter Settlement', 'Plant Sapling', 'Found Settlement' are low-contrast grey-on-teal and hovering 2s shows nothing (Found Settlement needs 50 wood, stated only in the Objective box). 'Village: 0/4' with a yellow swatch only makes sense after clicking the Era box. Config 'Chunk Size', 'Location Scale', 'Lag Prevention', 'Respawn Pawns' have no explanation or tooltip.
findings.repro: in world: pt move 400 517; pt wait 2; pt shot

findings.title: Objective 2 'Eat something' completes on its own without the player eating
findings.detail: Completed 48 ticks after objective 1 with apples 4 + 2 reward = 6, none consumed; the player never sees what it asked or how to eat (Inventory screen has no eat action).
findings.repro: pt start --seed 109; begin; walkto tree; e; e; pt events 10

findings.title: E next to a rock chops an overlapping tree; no indicator of the E target
findings.detail: walkto rock (2.5m) then E, as tip 3 says, gave 'Gathered 4 wood and 3 apples from tree'. No highlight/prompt shows which object E will act on.

findings.title: Overlay screens (Inventory, Nations/Laws, Pause, Share) draw text with no backing panel over the world and player
findings.detail: Inventory 'Apples: 6/Saplings: 2', Pause 'World seed 109' and Share URL sit over the player capsule; Laws first line crosses tree trunks at the horizon. Stale status 'Objective complete: Eat something.' lingers on Crafting/Nations screens minutes later.
findings.repro: in world: i; then o; then Escape

findings.title: Controls help lists F2-F6 debug cheats and uses touch wording 'Era box (tap)'
findings.detail: Page 3 'Debug' shows spawn coins/wood/pawns to all players. Page 2 says 'Era box (tap)' for a mouse player and never says where the box is. Page 3 Prev/Close pair is off-centre.

findings.title: Jargon: 'Export replay (USD)', 'border quarrels stop at Rival', 'day 1/2' vs 'Day 1/3'
findings.detail: 'USD' reads as US dollars; 'Rival' is an undefined relation level; Season panel 'day 1/2' (day of season) sits beside Era checklist 'Day 1/3' (days needed) with different meanings. Config Volume says sound only plays in the browser version.

findings.title: Destructive 'Leave Nation' is the most prominent HUD button
findings.detail: Bright red full-width button directly below the action row; no confirmation observed on hover. Easy misclick for a leader.

verdict: Text is almost always plain-language and the in-world dark panels, crafting cards, Controls pages and error banners read well. The main accessibility problems are low contrast on the light-blue menu screens, HUD panels that move and overlap (Inventory Info jumps mid-screen and gets covered by tips), a translucent Chronicle window, and a recent-chronicle panel that truncates every line. Nothing is explained on hover anywhere, so disabled buttons and Config jargon go unexplained.
